notes.title: 0.3.2 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s New
Added section to credits for the incredible Harmonicord playtesters!
Bug Fixes
Fixed a localization issue causing the game to misbehave in countries that use commas as the decimal point character.



Join the Discord to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates!

notes.title: 0.3.1 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s New
Added logging to facilitate easier debugging of issues found by playtesters.
Bug Fixes
Objects can once again be carried through doorways.

NPCs no longer become super fast after being carried back and forth through doors.



Join the Discord to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates!



[img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg"]

notes.title: 0.3.0 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s New
New NPCs!

A new ability!

Lots of new areas.

Direction of travel indicator for yanking lasso action while swinging.

Playtest exit survey.
Changes
Input method now switches dynamically between controller and keyboard-mouse, based on which is in use.

Updated speech bubble layout to make them more readable.

Color palette updates.
Bug Fixes
NPCs can once again be picked up and yeeted around.



Join the Discord to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates!



[img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg"]

notes.title: 0.2.0 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
What’s New
Added Discord link to title screen.

Added “Give Feedback” button to pause menu to allow users to submit reports via Discord, Google Forms, or the Steam Community.  
Changes
Updated title screen logo.  
Bug Fixes
Game no longer registers inputs when the window is not in focus.

Title screen lasso animation is now positioned and scaled correctly.



Join the Discord to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates!
